changeSet.author: ttn
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE knowledge_document ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, doc_number VARCHAR(100), doc_type VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('LAW','DECREE','CIRCULAR','MANUAL','INTERNAL')), issued_date DATE, effective_from DATE, effective_to DATE, superseded_by UUID REFERENCES knowledge_document(id), source_url VARCHAR(1000), file_id UUID REFERENCES uploaded_file(id), status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','INGESTING','READY','FAILED','ARCHIVED')), chunk_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, embedding_model VARCHAR(100), error_message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_document_effective ON knowledge_document (status, effective_from, effective_to); CREATE TABLE knowledge_chunk ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_document(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_index INT NOT NULL, heading_path TEXT NOT NULL, article_no VARCHAR(20), clause_no VARCHAR(20), content TEXT NOT NULL, token_count INT NOT NULL, embedding vector(1024) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_knowledge_chunk_doc_idx UNIQUE (document_id, chunk_index) ); CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_chunk_embedding ON knowledge_chunk USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops); CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_chunk_document ON knowledge_chunk (document_id);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE knowledge_chunk; DROP TABLE knowledge_document;
